# ETCP (Entertainment Technician Certification Program)

> > Professional certification program for entertainment technicians, offering rigger and electrician credentials based on ANSI standards.

ETCP is administered by ESTA (Entertainment Services and Technology Association) and provides industry-recognized certification for entertainment riggers and electricians working in theatre, arena, and live event production. The program is supported by major industry organizations including IATSE, AVIXA, AMPTP, and the Themed Entertainment Association.

## Key Topics

- Entertainment Technician Certification Program (ETCP)
- ESTA (Entertainment Services and Technology Association)
- Rigger certification
- Electrician certification

- Theatre safety
- Professional certification

- Arena and theatre production
- Technical training

- Industry credentials

## Getting Started

- [ETCP Homepage](https://etcp.esta.org/): Main portal for entertainment technician certification, including rigger and electrician credential programs

## Rigger Certification

- [Rigger Certification Exam Preparation](https://etcp.esta.org/certify/educational_rigger.html): Educational resources, exam prep materials, and ANSI rigging standards guide for rigger certification candidates

## Electrician Certification

- [Electrician Certification Exam Preparation](https://etcp.esta.org/certify/educational_electrical.html): Exam preparation resources and ANSI standards materials for entertainment electrician certification
